name: WPA Research Production Pipeline
purpose: Convert verified research candidates and user-supplied evidence notes into structured, downloadable WPA research drafts, then route them to governed human review and public publication channels.
boundaries: Draft generation is local in the browser and does not publish automatically.
Source candidates remain unverified until human verification.
No DOI is minted by this tool.
Final publication, DOI deposit, journal acceptance and public claims require human review and the applicable editorial/governance workflow.
The tool preserves source/provenance fields supplied by the user but does not verify external claims itself.
human_gate: A generated draft may become a public WPA output only after source verification, author/editor review, correction checks and explicit publication approval.
